words.sentence: I wrote a report about how butterflies grow.
I will support my friend by helping her walk safely.
It is important to wear a helmet when riding a bicycle.
Dad packed his passport before our trip to another country.
Our car stays dry under the roof of the carport.
Farmers export peaches to sell them in another country.
We watched an airplane land at the airport.
The reporter asked questions and shared the news.
We stepped through the stone portal into the garden.
The cargo ship stopped at the seaport to unload its containers.
The porter helped travelers carry their heavy suitcases.
My portable radio is small enough to carry to the park.

vocab.title: Weekly Vocabulary
vocab.groupsNote: Study all six purple-outlined words for Friday’s vocabulary quiz. The teacher’s definitions are kept as printed. Extra notes explain demolition, precious, assigned, and retains. Poetry and point of view are reading topics on the sheet; they are not listed among the six quiz words.

words.sentence: We watched the demolition of an empty building from a safe distance.
words.fill: The tearing down of an old building is called ___.
words.kid: The act of tearing down or destroying something.
words.note: The class sheet gives an action. Demolition is the name of that action.

words.def: tasks that take time and effort to complete
words.sentence: Our science projects took several days of planning and building.
words.fill: Tasks that need time and effort to finish are called ___.

words.def: something that is important or valuable
words.sentence: The old family photograph is precious to me.
words.fill: The necklace is ___ to me because it belonged to Grandma.
words.note: The class sheet describes something valuable. Precious describes how important or valuable it is.

words.def: a task given to you for someone to complete
words.sentence: Our teacher assigned me the job of watering the class plant.
words.fill: The teacher ___ each student a job to complete.
words.kid: Gave someone a task to do.
words.note: The class sheet describes a task. Assigned tells what someone did when giving the task.

words.def: pictures or patterns made from small pieces of glass, stone, or other materials
words.sentence: We made colorful mosaics by arranging small pieces of tile.
words.fill: Pictures made by fitting many small pieces of glass or stone together are ___.

words.def: something that you have and keep it
words.sentence: She retains her favorite teddy bear even when she gives other toys away.
words.fill: He ___ his old baseball glove, which means he keeps it.
words.kid: Keeps or continues to have something.
words.note: The class sheet describes something kept. Retains means keeps or continues to have.
